item.text: {"search_note":"I did not find strong 2024 reporting tying Tshisekedi’s immediate family to explicit appointments, donor patronage, or named business associates in government. I also did not find solid evidence of an openly nepotistic cabinet built around relatives. The stronger pattern is coalition patronage, loyal allies, and a mix of technocrats plus power-preserving appointments.
